title: Local Rate Index — US Metropolitan Service Price Quartiles, Statutory Fee Caps & State-License Verification Datasets (2026)
description: Anonymized ZIP-level and metropolitan service rate quartiles (p25, median/p50, p75 USD), municipal/police statutory fee caps, and public-record sample counts across 7 regulated B2B, commercial compliance, and specialty emergency verticals (Water Damage & TMARR Mold Remediation, LA OPG Heavy-Duty Commercial Towing, ALTA/NSPS Land Surveying, ASTM E1527-21 Phase I ESA, TX TDLR Property Tax Protest, Structural Slab Foundation Piering, and NFPA 96 Commercial Kitchen Hood & Municipal FOG Compliance). Calibrated against 97,000+ primary government records from City of Dallas Socrata APIs, US EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS), Texas TDLR, and Los Angeles Police Commission OPG schedules.
